author: Yffe
content: Code: lean/Thermite/Denote.lean denote's specCall arm — at fuel 0 OR an unresolved Env.specs name it bottoms to True ('At fuel 0 / an unresolved name it bottoms to True (IDENTICAL to refDenote's bottom — T1 holds at fuel 0)'). That dodge is sound for T1 (an EQUALITY of two identically-fuelled denotations) but NOT for the one-sided exported obligation the doc sketches in §1/§4 ('theorem item_xyz : forall env, reqDenote ... -> denote fuel ens ... ' with fuel free/unspecified): stated existentially or at insufficient fuel, a spec-fn-calling ens denotes True and a WRONG program certifies vacuously; likewise an exporter that fails to populate the registry for a called spec-fn makes the obligation True at EVERY fuel. The doc lists 'spec-fns via the fuel-indexed registry' IN (§8/AC-6) and never names the fuel-adequacy question; the spine's fuel-uniformity argument it leans on (thermite-semantics.md) covers T1 only. Correction: REQ-6 must pin the obligation's fuel form (e.g. forall fuel >= a derived sufficient bound from the dec-bounded registry, or an adequacy lemma), and the EXP trust item must explicitly include registry-population faithfulness (an omitted spec-fn = a vacuously-true obligation).
